title: Executive Assistant
model: written by hand in a Claude Code session, 2026-10-07

criteria.question: Tell us about the people you have supported as an executive or personal assistant, and for how long.
criteria.source_quote: Two or more years as an executive or personal assistant, ideally supporting more than one person, in an international company where the working language was English.
criteria.looks_like: Two or more years as an executive or personal assistant, ideally for several people, in an international, English-speaking company.

criteria.question: How do you use English in your work day to day?
criteria.looks_like: Reliable working English: emails, calls, messages.

criteria.question: Are you based in Madrid, with the right to work in Spain?
criteria.source_quote: Already in Madrid, with the right to work in Spain.
criteria.looks_like: Lives in Madrid and can work in Spain without a visa sponsorship.

criteria.question: Tell us about a travel or schedule plan that fell apart, and what you did.
criteria.looks_like: Cancelled flights, rebooked travel, rescheduled meetings handled without drama.

criteria.question: How have you handled confidential calendars, contracts or personal details?
criteria.looks_like: Trusted with confidential and personal information.

criteria.question: What have you got done with ChatGPT, Claude or a similar tool recently?
criteria.source_quote: Curious about AI, already using it.
criteria.looks_like: Real work done with ChatGPT, Claude or similar tools: drafting, triage, comparing options, automating a routine.

criteria.question: Have you supported founders or a leadership team at a startup or scale-up?
criteria.source_quote: You've supported founders or a leadership team at a startup or scale-up.
criteria.looks_like: Assistant to founders or a leadership team in a startup or scale-up.

criteria.question: Have you organised an office move or set up a workspace?
criteria.source_quote: You've organised an office move or set up a new workspace from scratch.
criteria.looks_like: An office move or a new workspace set up end to end.

criteria.question: Have you run team events or offsites?
criteria.source_quote: You've run team events or offsites for 20+ people end to end.
criteria.looks_like: Team events or offsites for twenty or more people, end to end.

criteria.question: Do you speak Spanish?
criteria.source_quote: Spanish is a plus for dealing with local suppliers and landlords.

criteria.question: How do you run several busy calendars across time zones?
criteria.looks_like: Calendars of several executives across time zones.

criteria.question: How do you book and rebook complex travel?
criteria.looks_like: Flights, hotels, trains across Europe, the US and the Middle East.

criteria.question: How would you run a coworking space and then an office move?
criteria.looks_like: Supplies, access, guests, deliveries, then an office.

criteria.question: What routine have you automated, or would you?
criteria.looks_like: Recurring admin handed to AI agents and automation tools.
